content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am writing to review the agreement and would like to propose a few adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating "Except as otherwise detailed in this Agreement, the Parties acknowledge and agree that the Subject Program including without limitation the Deliverables and Documentation (collectively, the Works) are "work made for hire" in accordance with the U.S. Copyright Act, 17 U.S.C. § 101 et seq.", ownership of your work transfers to the client immediately upon creation or delivery rather than waiting for full payment, leaving you without leverage if payment is delayed; therefore, we propose changing this so that ownership of the Deliverables shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has made full payment of all fees due under this Agreement, upon which ownership shall transfer to the Client. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to moving forward.
